'''Jago''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], he went on a mission to recover intel on a satellite system which was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He was able to retrieve the intel from the Balmorran satellite until his ship was shot down by Imperials. Before he was [[Death/Legends|killed]], he was able to eject the intel from his ship. Eventually, a Republic individual was able to find his body in the shipwreck and recover all of Jago's intel.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jago appears in the mission "From the Wreckage" for Republic classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
